# Eimu API — LLM/Agent Reference

Base URL: https://eimu.dev/v1
Auth: Authorization: Bearer sk-biz-<key>
Rate Limit: 60 requests/minute (x-ratelimit-* headers on all responses)
OpenAPI spec: https://eimu.dev/v1/openapi.json

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Sync? | Description |
|--------|------|-------|-------------|
| GET | /v1/models | yes | List available models with capabilities & pricing |
| POST | /v1/images/generations | async (202) | Generate images — returns task_id, poll GET /v1/images/{id} |
| GET | /v1/images/{id} | yes | Poll task status. Does NOT consume rate limit. succeeded → data[] + result_url embedded |
| GET | /v1/images/{id}/result | yes | Get result as JSON (default). Add ?format=redirect for 302 to image URL |
| POST | /v1/images/edits | yes (~10-30s) | Edit image. Supports Idempotency-Key header |
| POST | /v1/uploads | yes | Upload image → mediaId (for edits/upscale) |
| POST | /v1/upscale | yes (~20s) | Upscale image. Supports Idempotency-Key header |
| POST | /v1/videos/generations | async (202) | Generate video — same task pattern as images |
| GET | /v1/videos/{id} | yes | Poll video task status |
| GET | /v1/videos/{id}/result | yes | Get video result: {video_url, data[]} |

## Async Pattern (images & videos)

1. POST /v1/images/generations → 202 + Location: /v1/images/{id}
2. Poll GET /v1/images/{id} every 3-5s until status = "succeeded" or "failed"
3. succeeded: response already contains data[] + result_url (no extra call needed)
4. Optional: pass callback_url in the POST body to receive a webhook when done

## Error Format

All errors: { "error": { "message": "...", "type": "...", "code": "...", "param": null, "trace_id": "..." } }
Include X-Request-Id header = trace_id value

## Models

Fetch GET /v1/models for current list. Each model includes:
- x_coins_per_image.standard / x_coins_per_image.hd (may be absent if same as standard)
- x_capabilities: { aspectRatios, resolutions, qualityModes, referenceImages, lora, defaultAspectRatio, defaultResolution }
- x_docs_url, x_openapi_url

## Key Rules for Agents

- NEVER poll in the same turn you submitted — fire-and-forget, let the caller resume you
- NEVER embed base64 image URLs in responses — always use url format
- Always call image_quote (GET /v1/models) before charging to confirm price
- 429: wait Retry-After + jitter before retrying; failed requests still count against quota
- 402 insufficient_quota: tell user to top up, do NOT retry
- Polling (GET /v1/images/{id}) does NOT consume rate limit quota
